title: TaskDone
description: The payload of task.done/v1 (M1 slice plan §1 admission; D51; I22): an admitted task ended, terminally: as a candidate (M1(a)'s template variant: its review's go selected, merge inactive), or abandoned, its approval no longer in force (reason authority_revoked; #226 entry 100). It frees admission: the next task is admitted only once the admitted one is done. internal/authority admits it only under its task's id and project, by a live system actor at its event's time, of the admitted task: a candidate with none of its current nodes claimed or held; an abandonment with its approval not in force and no live lease on any of its nodes.

as.description: What the task ended as: candidate, the end of M1(a)'s template; or abandoned, with no candidate.

reason.description: Why an abandoned task ended (authority_revoked: its approval is no longer in force); null for a candidate.
